abstract: OBJECTIVES: To review a large experience with sperm cryopreservation in patients with testicular cancer and determine the effect of clinical stage and tumor histologic features on semen quality. METHODS: The prefreeze and post-thaw sperm quality of 157 patients with testicular cancer was compared with that of 50 normal donors. The impact of tumor stage and histologic features (pure seminoma, pure embryonal, or mixed germ cell) was also determined. A computer-assisted semen analysis was performed before and after cryopreservation. The motile sperm count (MSC), motility, and motion characteristics were measured before and after cryopreservation and compared between groups. RESULTS: Patients with testicular cancer had lower prefreeze and post-thaw MSC and motility compared with normal donors (P = 0.0001 for both). The curvilinear velocity and linearity were also significantly less in patients with testicular cancer (P <0.05 for both). The percentage of change in the semen characteristics did not differ between patients and donors, indicating that sperm from both patients and donors withstood the cryopreservation process equally well. Tumor stage (n = 143) and histologic features (n = 136) did not significantly influence semen quality. No individual histologic component significantly influenced MSC or motility. CONCLUSIONS: The effect of cryopreservation on sperm was similar in patients with testicular cancer and donors. Patients with poor prefreeze semen quality have poor post-thaw semen quality, and the effects of cryopreservation were not significantly affected by histologic features or stage. Our results indicate that routine sperm banking should be recommended for men with a diagnosis of testicular cancer to preserve future fertility potential.
abstract_ja:
目的: 精巣がん患者における精子凍結保存の経験を検討し、腫瘍の臨床病期と組織学的特徴が精液の質に与える影響を明らかにすること。
方法: 精巣がん患者157例の凍結前後の精子の質を、正常ドナー50例と比較した。腫瘍の病期(n=143)と組織学的特徴(純粋セミノーマ、純粋胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍)の影響も評価した。コンピュータ支援精液分析を凍結前後に実施し、運動精子数(MSC)、運動能、運動特性を測定して群間で比較した。
結果: 精巣がん患者は、凍結前後とも MSC と運動能がドナーより低かった(P = 0.0001、両指標とも)。曲線速度と直線性も有意に低かった(P<0.05、両指標とも)。精液特性の変化率は患者とドナーで差がなく、両群の精子は凍結過程に同等に耐えたことが示された。腫瘍の病期(n=143)と組織学的特徴(n=136)は精液の質に有意な影響を与えなかった。いずれの組織成分も MSC や運動能に有意な影響を与えなかった。
結論: 凍結の影響は精巣がん患者とドナーで同様だった。凍結前の精液の質が低い患者は凍結後も低い。凍結の影響は組織学的特徴や病期によって有意に変わらなかった。精巣がんと診断された男性には、将来の妊孕性を温存するため、日常的な精子バンキングを推奨すべきである。
